summary: The most consequential gap is that the same-week referral warning signs (skin changes, lump with risk features, axillary lump, nipple discharge) are entirely unencoded, with no check items or priority/possible rule. The abscess, mastitis, engorgement and blocked duct rules match the page correctly; the mastalgia rule is circular (diagnosis equals the symptom concept).
